summary: DayZ entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: DayZ
entries.definitive_edition: Current PC standalone with exact server/map/mod state documented

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC standalone on documented server/ruleset with exact mods

primary.why: DayZ standalone is distinct from the original Arma 2 mod, and the PC route is best for capture, modding, community servers, and configuration. Exact server/map/mod state must be recorded because gameplay differs heavily by community setup.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Steam PC standalone. Record build, server, map, mods, DLC/map ownership, ruleset, character state, first/third-person setting, graphics/audio settings, and whether the Arma 2 DayZ mod or console versions were compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Document separately if covering the historical mod.
secondary.why: The standalone is the named 2018 game route.
PC is the best server/mod/capture route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not merge with the Arma 2 DayZ mod; document DLC/map ownership.
